What the salon does

Dog grooming

Wash, blow dry and a tidy trim, from poodles and spaniels to huskies. Customers write that their dogs come out looking and smelling great.

Cat grooming

16 Google reviews are about cat grooming. Products that help cats relax, such as head bubbles and silicone mitts, and a quick groom so they spend less time being handled.

Teeth and claws

Teeth cleaning with the latest products and claws trimmed, as customers describe on Google.

Nervous and older pets

Patience for shy, scared or elderly pets. One customer describes three weeks of short visits until her frightened dog was ready to be groomed.

From the salon

Photos the salon posted on its Google listing.

A calm salon

What customers notice on Google.

No other animals

No other animals around, soft music and a comfortably cool room, as one customer describes.

Two pairs of hands

The same customer noticed the groom was done by two people, which felt safer and more comfortable for her cat.

Parking next door

Parking right next to the salon, and the entrance is wheelchair accessible, according to Google.

The rainbow front on Okeanias

The Furry Godmother sits at Okeanias 17 in Oroklini, behind a rainbow front with cartoon dogs and two wooden chairs outside. It is women-owned and marked as LGBTQ+ friendly on Google. Customers write that the owner treats every animal as if it were her own, and one travels all the way from Limassol with her husky and her cat.
